title: Student Mastery
description: Runtime contract for one student's aggregated mastery state on a single taxonomy node. Stored in the mastery DB table; updated from student events.

taxonomyCode.description: Taxonomy node code this mastery row tracks, e.g. 'SAT_RW:transitions'

idkCount.description: Number of 'I don't know' events on this node

recencyWeightedAccuracy.description: Accuracy with recent attempts weighted more heavily, in [0, 1]

lastSeenAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent event on this node
